publish.title: AI Agents Are Leaving the Screen
publish.caption:
AI agents are moving beyond software-only workflows. Anthropic's new Model Hardware Standard research preview is designed to connect agents with programmable physical equipment.

The operational takeaway is bigger than the hardware: capability, permission and stop conditions have to be designed separately.

Practical control framework: https://stratumpraxis.com/agentic-ai-governance-permission-kit.html?utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=physical-ai-control-20260827
